About this Event

💃 GIRLS NIGHT OUT – THE ULTIMATE INDIAN DJ PARTY! ✨
Get ready for a night full of glamour, music, dancing, and unforgettable memories! 💖
MAD ENTERTAINMENTS invites you to an exciting Girls Night DJ Party featuring the best of Bollywood, Tollywood, Punjabi hits, and trending Indian party anthems!
Grab your girlfriends, dress to impress, and get ready to own the dance floor with non-stop beats, electrifying DJ mixes, amazing lights, and incredible party vibes!
Whether it's dancing with your besties, celebrating friendship, or simply enjoying a night out, this is your chance to let loose and have fun!
💨 Desi Hookah Available! Enjoy authentic desi hookah flavors while soaking in the ultimate party atmosphere.
🥂 Good Music. Great Friends. Unforgettable Nights.
👠 Dress up. 💄 Bring your glam. 💃 Own the night!
Presented by MAD ENTERTAINMENTS
🔥 Don't miss the ultimate Indian Girls Night Party. Get your tickets now!
